purpose: Record source-pattern findings for the non-literal SQL sites newly visible after adding the registered synthesis-agent worker closure. This is not an ACL or runtime authorization approval.

reviewed_patterns.pattern: agent projection SQL with fixed location predicates
reviewed_patterns.finding: The interpolated SQL predicate is returned by each module's fixed _location_filter helper, called with the literal location_id column. Location values and other data are passed separately as bound parameters; the projection names and SQL structure are source literals. This establishes a source pattern only, not the live grant or view policy.
The relation fragment is selected only by direct calls that pass literal view names from synthesize_kokonut_commons; location values are bound. The helper is not approved as an unrestricted SQL API.

The role identifier comes from the immutable source-owned _SYNTHESIS_WORKERS entry selected by the registered task key, not from a CLI role argument. Live role grants and database identity provisioning remain unverified here.

The builder rejects tables outside _SOURCE_REFERENCE_TABLES; predicate and ordering fragments are supplied by code-owned summary scope definitions. Location and source values are bound. The SQL inventory remains conservative because the statement is assembled from these fixed components.

Every call reachable from the registered worker passes a module-owned literal query template and separately bound parameters. This finding is limited to the current source graph and does not make the helper safe for arbitrary external callers.

The registered worker verifies the concrete agent class and its metadata against the immutable task registry. A class-specific query override is source-owned; the default builder validates table/view identifiers and scope against closed patterns. Location values are bound. The generic cursor call therefore remains UNKNOWN in the automated inventory.

The loop executes one of the fixed SQL strings in the local checks mapping and binds the requested location separately. The signed agent sets a restricted kokonut_agent_source search path before invoking these calculations.
The loop executes literal statements from the local query tuple and binds the signed location. The optional source schema is checked against the fixed supported values before this branch.
